# Sprite sources are generated by scripts/generate-pixel-sprites.py from
# assets/pixel/*.pxart. Globbing keeps this file from needing an edit every time
# a sprite is added; the generated tree is committed so builds never depend on
# Python being available.
#
# CONFIGURE_DEPENDS re-runs the glob when the directory changes, so adding a
# sprite does not need a manual reconfigure. It is rejected in CMake script mode,
# which is how ESP-IDF gathers component requirements, so it has to be omitted on
# that pass - the requirement pass does not use the source list anyway.
if(CMAKE_SCRIPT_MODE_FILE)
    file(GLOB UI_PIXEL_ART_SPRITES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sprites/*.c")
else()
    file(GLOB UI_PIXEL_ART_SPRITES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
         "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sprites/*.c")
endif()

idf_component_register(SRCS ${UI_PIXEL_ART_SPRITES}
                       INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
                       REQUIRES lvgl)
